description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ScreenPermissionDao component in the OrangeHRM system. It tests retrieval of screen permissions for different user roles and verifies permission flags.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing ScreenPermissionDao functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads test fixtures, and creates an instance of ScreenPermissionDao.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermission
methods.description: Runs various assertions to verify the behavior of getScreenPermissions method for different roles and permission scenarios.

methods.name: verifyPermissions
methods.description: Helper method to check that the permissions object has expected read, create, update, and delete flags.
